title: Lighthouse Weather Journal Archive Ingestion
originalRequest: Digitize and validate the legacy weather journal logs from the Cape Point station.
latestMessage: Digitize and validate the legacy weather journal logs from the Cape Point station.

steps.title: Parse and digitize October 1923 logs
steps.instruction: Extract daily barometric pressure and wind velocity readings from the physical journal scan of October 1923.
steps.acceptance: All 31 database rows created with valid numerical values mapped to timestamped entries.
steps.result: Blocked during processing. Attempt 1 by agent joker-codex: The journal pages corresponding to October 12 through October 18 are heavily deteriorated due to salt-water exposure, making the handwritten barometric logs completely unreadable. Ingestion halted due to illegible source material; awaiting manual physical inspection or restoration.
